title.zh: 美国阿肯色州起诉Kalshi，指控其经营非法平台
title.en: 美国阿肯色州起诉Kalshi，指控其经营非法平台

current_state.zh: Arkansas Attorney General Tim Griffin sued KalshiEX LLC and Kalshi Inc., alleging the prediction market operates an unlicensed illegal gambling platform, offers real-money sports and entertainment betting to users including 18-year-olds, and violates state deceptive trade practices law, while seeking damages, fines, taxes, and an injunction.
